description: This line plot illustrates the training loss over training steps for six different model architectures, all trained on a dataset of 20 million data points. The x-axis, labeled “Step,” represents the training step number and is marked with values from 0K to 440K, indicating a linear scale with tick labels spaced at intervals of 20K (0K, 20K, 40K, 60K, 80K, 420K, 430K, 440K). The y-axis, labeled “Train Loss,” is also on a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 0.85, with major gridlines and tick marks at intervals of 0.2 (0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8). Six distinct colored lines represent the models: a red line for ChemBART Small 20M, a blue line for ChemBART Medium 20M, a green line for ChemBERTa Small 20M, an orange line for ChemBERTa Medium 20M, a purple line for ChemLLaMA Small 20M, and a brown line for ChemLLaMA Medium 20M. All lines begin at a high training loss near 0.75 at step 0K and exhibit a rapid initial decline, stabilizing at a low loss value near 0.05–0.10 after approximately 40K steps. The green line (ChemBERTa Small 20M) consistently remains below all other lines throughout training, while the red line (ChemBART Small 20M) starts slightly above the green line but converges to a similar low loss value. The brown line (ChemLLaMA Medium 20M) begins near the top of the loss range and follows a similar trajectory to the other models, stabilizing near the bottom of the loss range. The lines show significant noise, indicated by jagged fluctuations, particularly in the early stages of training.
